equivalent.MM14: a mandate that is not its lineage's active mandate is always REVOKED: E1 revokes the predecessor in the same transaction that makes the successor active, so the status test of consume already refuses it
equivalent.MM15: retire requires block.timestamp >= expiresAt and consume refuses block.timestamp >= expiresAt, so a retired mandate is always expired and refused by the time test
equivalent.SV03: ctx.predecessorId is built by the manager from auth.predecessorId, so the comparison cannot differ; it stays as a guard for a context built another way
equivalent.GW13: the manager compares the hash of the supplied pin with the stored one and raises the same PinHashMismatch
equivalent.AL02: the ecrecover precompile itself returns no address for a v other than 27 and 28
equivalent.AL04: a call to an account without code returns no data, and the next line refuses return data shorter than one word
